source_caption:
Not Without My Daughter is a tense and emotional survival drama based on the memoir of Betty Mahmoody. Starring Sally Field, the film follows an American woman who travels to Iran with her husband and young daughter, only to find herself trapped when he refuses to let them return home.

What begins as a family visit gradually becomes a story of courage, resilience, and a mother’s determination to protect her child at any cost. As Betty realizes the danger of her situation, every decision carries enormous risk, turning the film into a gripping tale of survival against overwhelming odds.

Sally Field’s performance anchors the story, portraying a woman forced to find strength she never knew she possessed. The film’s most powerful moments come not from action or spectacle, but from the emotional bond between a mother and daughter trying to hold onto hope in an increasingly desperate situation.

Beyond its suspense, Not Without My Daughter is a story about perseverance and the lengths a parent will go to for their child. Decades later, it remains memorable because its central theme is universal: when family is at stake, fear becomes secondary to love.

source_details.synopsis: Not Without My Daughter is a 1991 American drama film based on the 1987 book of the same name. It depicts the escape of American citizen Betty Mahmoody and her daughter, Mahtob, from her abusive ex-husband Sayyed "Moody" Bozorg Mahmoody in Iran. Filming was done in 1990 in the United States and Israel, and the main characters Betty and Moody are played by Sally Field and Alfred Molina, respectively. Sheila Rosenthal and Roshan Seth co-star as Mahtob and Houssein the smuggler, respectively.
